about: Formulas over many channels: vector tokens, severity() and connected(); and label(), the enum string of a channel's value. One table for every evaluator of the formula language. A channel is {value, severity 0-3, labels: its enum strings when it has them}; with "down" its connection is lost (a value given is stale and must not be read); a channel not listed has no sample. "nonFinite" is a number that JSON cannot hold. Expect a value with the result's severity and vectorInputs (null: no such key), or an error class: input_missing, type_error, parse_error. missingListed sets the cap on listed members (default 20).
